sources.title: Original T5 release README
sources.evidence: The initial repository commit explicitly lists T5-3B among released checkpoints and links gs://t5-data/pretrained_models/3B. It describes text-to-text pretraining and fine-tuning and calls 512 the default sequence length.

sources.title: Original T5 release commit metadata
sources.evidence: Root commit is dated October 23, 2019 at 23:34:41 UTC; its README already states the checkpoints have been released. Corroborates the paper submission date; a later Google blog is not used as this model release date.

sources.title: Original Google T5-3B operative configuration
sources.evidence: Exact original 3B configuration: 24 encoder and 24 decoder layers, d_model=1024, d_ff=16384, d_kv=128, 32 heads, shared encoder/decoder embeddings and shared decoder embedding/softmax weights. Uses all_mix pretraining with span corruption. Both training inputs and targets/max_length are 512; absolute positional embedding is disabled.

sources.title: Original Google T5-3B checkpoint index
sources.evidence: Downloaded only the 22,168-byte TensorFlow SSTable index, not checkpoint weight shards. Parsed 1,404 metadata entries; after excluding optimizer slots and global_step, 509 model tensors sum to 2,851,598,336 elements. Encoder 1,208,010,752; decoder 1,610,688,512; shared embedding 32,899,072. Two relative-bias tables exist, both self-attention; no cross-attention relative-bias parameter. These counts agree independently with the exact architecture formula.

sources.title: T5-3B checkpoint model card
sources.evidence: Exact original T5-3B checkpoint card identifies the Google researchers, Apache 2.0, text-to-text inputs/outputs and mixed unsupervised/supervised pretraining. The card was written by Hugging Face and is distinguished from the original Google release evidence. No dedicated thinking mode or native function-calling claim appears.

sources.title: Pinned T5-3B configuration
sources.evidence: Configuration matches the original 3B dimensions: 24 layers per stack, hidden 1024, FFN 16384, 32 heads of size 128, 32 relative buckets, vocabulary 32128. is_encoder_decoder=true and n_positions=512. It is original T5, not T5 v1.1 or Flan-T5-XL.

sources.title: Pinned converted T5-3B safetensors header
sources.evidence: Read HTTP 206 bytes 0-7 and 8-62815 only. Header has 510 F32 tensors totaling 2,851,599,360 elements; byte offsets reconcile. Shared token/output embedding is stored once. One extra 1,024-element decoder cross-attention relative-bias tensor is absent from the original index and explicitly ignored by the supported implementation. No packed quantization or buffer tensors are counted as model parameters.

sources.title: Pinned T5 implementation
sources.evidence: T5ForConditionalGeneration ties encoder/decoder/output embeddings and explicitly ignores decoder.block.0.layer.1.EncDecAttention.relative_attention_bias.weight. Cross-attention is constructed without relative bias. Layer norms have scale only; self-attention relative-bias tables are shared across layers. Dynamic relative-position computation uses input sequence lengths; no n_positions hard-cap lookup is used.

sources.title: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer
sources.evidence: Original submission October 23, 2019; inspected full paper including later revision. Section 3.7 specifies original 3B architecture and approximately 2.8B parameters, while the3B name is rounded. Dense encoder-decoder Transformer, tied output embedding, shared relative-position biases,512-token training and multitask pretraining are documented. No separately defined inference active-parameter count for exact 3B is supplied.

sources.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners, Appendix D
sources.evidence: A later comparative training-compute estimate lists nominal T5-3B = 3000M and assumes 0.5 of parameters active per training token, ignoring attention. This approximate encoder/decoder training accounting is not a Google-disclosed, phase-independent inference active count and is not converted into an asserted 1.5B model field.

sources.title: Original T5 Apache 2.0 license
sources.evidence: Original project license is Apache 2.0; the exact T5-3B checkpoint card independently declares the same license.

name.note: Retain catalog spacing for the original T5-3B variant; the size label is nominal.

developer.note: Original Google Research release and research paper.

family.note: Original Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer family; not the later v1.1 or Flan checkpoint.

release_date.note: Retain the original repository-release date, corroborated by the paper submission, rather than later model-card/upload/blog dates.

open_weights.note: Original Google checkpoints and converted Hugging Face weights are publicly distributed; inspected only metadata and tensor headers.

license.note: Exact model card and original project license agree.

parameters_b.note: Complete original model: 2,851,598,336 parameters = encoder 1,208,010,752 + decoder 1,610,688,512 + shared embedding 32,899,072. Both stacks, attention, FFNs, scale-only normalization and two self-attention relative-bias tables are included; shared encoder/decoder/output token embedding is counted once. Original checkpoint index excludes optimizer state and global_step. Independently derived as E=24*(4*1024*4096+2*1024*16384+2*1024)+1024+32*32; D=24*(8*1024*4096+2*1024*16384+3*1024)+1024+32*32; shared=32128*1024. Converted F32 storage/API aggregate is 1,024 higher due to an unused cross-attention bias explicitly ignored on load. No weight payload was downloaded.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined inference active count is reported by the developer. Encoder processing and decoder generation have different parameter participation; do not equate dense total with per-token active count. OpenAI Appendix D uses an explicitly approximate half-model training-compute assumption, not a universal model inference count.

architecture.note: Dense encoder-decoder Transformer with 24 layers in each stack, ReLU FFNs, decoder cross-attention, relative-position biases and shared token/output embeddings; no routed experts.

context_window.note: 512 is the original training input/target length and legacy n_positions metadata. Dynamic relative-position implementation has no fixed 512-position embedding boundary, and the reviewed sources do not establish one deployment-independent supported maximum. Leave null rather than treating training length as a hard context cap or claiming unlimited effective context.

modalities.note: Original text-to-text model: NLP tasks are represented as input and output strings.

reasoning.note: Question-answering/NLI benchmarks do not establish a dedicated thinking or reasoning-mode capability for the original checkpoint; no explicit capability declaration verified.

tool_call.note: No native function-calling declaration verified for this original checkpoint. Downstream fine-tuning or generic text formatting is not treated as source-reported tool support.

description.value: Google's original dense encoder-decoder model for text-to-text tasks, pretrained on a mixture of span-corrupted text and supervised NLP tasks.
description.note: Plain description of original architecture and mixed pretraining; avoids conflation with later instruction-tuned Flan variants.

patch.description: Google's original dense encoder-decoder model for text-to-text tasks, pretrained on a mixture of span-corrupted text and supervised NLP tasks.
patch.notes: Total includes both encoder and decoder, with shared token/output embeddings counted once. The original checkpoint index gives 2,851,598,336 parameters; the converted file includes an extra 1,024-element cross-attention bias that the implementation ignores. 3B is a nominal size label. Training used 512-token inputs and targets; a universal hard context maximum is not established. Active parameters are not separately reported for inference.

sources.label: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer

summary: Replaces nominal 3B with exact complete original 2.851598336B, independently confirmed by Google checkpoint index, configuration arithmetic and converted-header reconciliation. Excludes optimizer state, duplicate tied embeddings and an unused conversion-only cross-attention bias. Confirms dense encoder-decoder architecture, Apache 2.0 and October 23, 2019 release. Training length 512 is not asserted as a hard context cap; active count, thinking mode and native tool capability remain unverified/undisclosed as appropriate.
